ui.question: Question {name}
ui.confirmBody: This situation is highly critical and warrants immediate termination. Are you certain you want to fire {name}?
ui.chooseTitle: Do you know who it is?
ui.firedNotice: Negligence will not be tolerated. The employee has been terminated effective immediately.
ui.evidenceEmpty: Nothing recorded yet. Open a workstation to start gathering evidence.

alert.label: Urgent
alert.body: IT just detected a massive data leak coming from your team's IPs. Someone is extracting the customer database. Find the person responsible immediately before the transfer is complete.

meeting.introBody: Help Marcus find the infiltrator. Notify the team about the breach and listen to their initial arguments.
meeting.hint: Click on each team member to hear their initial arguments.

quotes.mia: I checked the server logs and noticed unusual traffic to an external IP. Someone must have connected to a vulnerable network.
quotes.omar: I've been focused on putting together presentations. I only logged into some platforms to generate AI images...
quotes.leo: Guys, I don't understand much about networks. I barely manage to remember my password... my computer is definitely clean.
quotes.sara: I've been working from the coffee shop across the street all morning... I'm clean.

office.hint: Click on each team member to investigate.
office.blockedBody: You can't make a decision yet. You need more information to be absolutely sure. Investigate their workspaces first.

leo.observation: Look at his monitor. Is that his actual password on a sticky note? That's a massive security violation. Should we question Leo about this?
leo.question: Why do you have your password stuck to your monitor in plain sight?
leo.answer: Because they ask me to change it every month! Nobody from the outside enters this office anyway.

omar.observation: His inbox is flooded with spam, and he is logged into an unverified AI platform. Could that be the entry point? Should we interrogate Omar?
omar.question: Did you use your corporate email to register on those free pages?
omar.answer: Yes! They were giving out free credits. Anyway, it's just for office stuff, I don't think they steal data.

sara.observation: Her laptop is connected to the coffee shop's open Wi-Fi network, and I don't see an active VPN. That exposes all her credentials. Do you want to question Sara?
sara.question: Were you working with the database from the coffee shop's open Wi-Fi?
sara.answer: Yes, but only for a little while. The company page has a little padlock (HTTPS), isn't that enough?

mia.observation: Wait, look closely behind her CPU. There is an unregistered USB drive plugged in, and a black console window is running a script. Do you want to question Mía?
mia.question: Why do you have an unregistered USB connected and a console running?
mia.answer: That USB has my music to help me focus. And the console is just a system update.

alert.label: Urgent
alert.body: The attack has not stopped! We know you terminated {name}, but IT just confirmed we made a mistake: The company is still at immense risk and the clock is ticking. Find the real infiltrator before the transfer is complete!

reasons.leo: While writing down passwords is a huge security risk, this is a remote data extraction. Nobody physically entered the office to steal that sticky note.
reasons.sara: Bypassing the VPN on a public network exposes credentials, but the massive database extraction is happening directly from our internal servers, not through her local connection.
reasons.omar: Clicking phishing links and using unverified AI tools is dangerous, but his machine was merely a decoy. The main extraction node is somewhere else.

meeting.introBody: Help Marcus find the infiltrator. Notify the team about the breach and listen to their initial arguments.
meeting.hint: Click on each team member to hear their initial arguments.

quotes.mia: The attack is accelerating. The central server is at 80% capacity. We have to find the leak right now!
quotes.omar: I already closed the AI pages! But I keep getting weird emails. I'm not sending anything out.
quotes.leo: I told you it wasn't me! I already took down my post-it, but the system is still slow. Someone else is doing something weird.
quotes.sara: I already connected to the office network cable, as requested. But my files are taking forever to load, the network is saturated.

office.hint: Click on each team member to investigate.
office.blockedBody: You can't make a decision yet. You need more information to be absolutely sure. Investigate their workspaces first.

leo.observation: This is a disaster. He didn't just save his passwords in a text file; he accidentally saved it in the public shared drive! Anyone in the building could have grabbed his credentials. Is he the infiltrator, or just the victim? Ask Leo.
leo.question: Leo, why is a file named 'My_Passwords.txt' sitting on the public shared drive?
leo.answer: I just clicked 'Save As'! I thought 'Public' meant my public desktop. I didn't know the whole company could see it!

omar.observation: Look at Omar's screen! There's a 'Remote Access' session active and his mouse is moving on its own. Someone from the outside is controlling his machine right now! Is he collaborating with them? Ask Omar.
omar.question: Omar, there is an active remote session on your PC. Who is controlling your machine right now?
omar.answer: I panicked! I opened that invoice and my PC froze. A pop-up said to call IT support and they asked for remote access... Was that not our real IT team?

sara.observation: Her firewall is disabled, and she is running a network scanner mapping all our internal IP addresses. That's exactly what a hacker does to find databases! Why is a designer scanning our network? We need to ask Sara.
sara.question: Sara, your firewall is off and you're running a network scanner. Are you looking for the main database?
sara.answer: The network is crawling! A tutorial said a network scanner could find a faster DNS channel for my design renders. I'm just trying to work!

mia.observation: Mía seems to be working normally. But... look at that black USB drive. The data light is flashing frantically. Why is it reading so much data if she's just typing? Ask Mía.
mia.question: Mía, why is your USB drive flashing so frantically if you are just typing a document?
mia.answer: It's just my music USB. The light always blinks when Windows indexes the files in the background. Everything is fine, Marcus.

alert.label: Urgent
alert.body: The attack has not stopped! We know you terminated {name}, but IT just confirmed we made a mistake: The company is still at immense risk and the clock is ticking. Find the real infiltrator before the transfer is complete!

reasons.leo: While leaving passwords on a public drive is a critical violation, his account was merely hijacked by the real infiltrator. Leo is just dangerously incompetent, not the hacker.
reasons.sara: Running unauthorized network tools is a fireable offense, but it was just a misguided attempt to fix her slow internet. The massive data extraction is not coming from her IP.
reasons.omar: He fell for a tech-support scam and gave a hacker remote access. However, they only used his PC as a distraction. The main database leak is happening physically.

meeting.introBody: Help Marcus find the infiltrator. Notify the team about the breach and listen to their initial arguments.
meeting.hint: Click on each team member to hear their initial arguments.

quotes.mia: Looks like we are the last ones. The evidence points to your equipment. I suggest you confess.
quotes.omar: I already talked to IT, I sent my equipment to quarantine because of the email I opened. I don't have network access anymore.
quotes.leo: It's just us left! I swear I don't even know how to open the command console! Check my machine!
quotes.sara: I've followed all the protocols today! There's no way it's me, it has to be Mia!

office.hint: Click on each team member to investigate.
office.blockedBody: You can't make a decision yet. You need more information to be absolutely sure. Investigate their workspaces first.

leo.observation: The hackers finally changed his password and locked him out of his own machine! He can't even log in. Is he covering his tracks, or is he just collateral damage? Ask Leo.
leo.question: Leo, your account is locked out due to multiple failed attempts. Are you trying to cover your tracks?
leo.answer: I can't get in! I tried 'Admin123', 'Admin1234', and it just locked me out! I swear I'm not doing this!

omar.observation: IT completely isolated Omar's computer from the main network an hour ago because of the remote access. If the leak is still active right now, it physically cannot be coming from his station! Ask Omar.
omar.question: Omar, IT quarantined your machine. Were you the one who authorized the remote access to our database?
omar.answer: My screen went black and says 'Quarantined'. I haven't been able to touch anything all morning! Please believe me, I'm locked out!

sara.observation: Sara panicked! She physically unplugged her ethernet cable to stop the attack, but her system completely crashed. If she's disconnected, how is the leak still happening? Ask Sara.
sara.question: Sara, your network cable is unplugged and your system crashed. Are you trying to hide the data leak?
sara.answer: The network was going crazy! I pulled the plug to stop whatever was happening, but my PC just died! It's not me, I'm disconnected!

mia.observation: Mía's screen... I've never seen her use raw hexadecimal code before. It's moving too fast. And look at that USB drive; the data light isn't blinking anymore, it's glowing solid red. Her machine is processing massive amounts of data locally! We need to ask Mía immediately.
mia.question: Mía, your machine is running raw hexadecimal code and your USB drive is glowing solid red. Are you copying our data locally?
mia.answer: Oh, Marcus! You startled me. I'm just learning some basic coding for a course I'm taking. I thought I'd run a quick test script on my personal USB to see if it works. It's just a practice exercise, really, nothing to worry about!

defeatReasons.leo: Leo was locked out of his own machine by the hackers who stole his credentials on day one. He could not be extracting data right now even if he wanted to.
defeatReasons.sara: Sara's machine crashed and is disconnected. An offline machine cannot upload a database. The real leak bypassed the network entirely.
defeatReasons.omar: Omar's PC was isolated by IT. He is a victim of a phishing attack, but the ongoing leak is bypassing our network firewalls altogether.

architect.headline: Threat neutralized!
architect.body: Incredible job! You detected the data extraction in its early stages and stopped Mía before the customer database left our network. Your intact team thanks you.
architect.lesson: You correctly identified that, although passwords on post-its or the use of public Wi-Fi are terrible practices, unauthorized USB devices and background scripts are the number one method for active data extraction.
architect.rank: You are a Zero Trust Architect!

neutralized.headline: Threat neutralized!
neutralized.body: You managed to stop Mía and save the main database, but we lost valuable time investigating the wrong person yesterday. There was a small leak of non-critical information, but the company will survive.
neutralized.lesson: You managed to see through the deception. Remember: in a cybersecurity incident, time is vital. Learning to prioritize between a 'bad office practice' (like downloading dubious files) and an 'active extraction attack' makes all the difference.

saved.headline: System saved at the last second!
saved.body: You stopped the transfer at 99%. We fired two innocent people in the process and the team is exhausted, but you prevented the company's bankruptcy. It was a tough case, but you did it.
saved.lesson: You let yourself be fooled by the common bad practices of your peers, but in the end, you detected the real breach. In the real world, the real infiltrators usually hide behind the mistakes of others.

compromised.headline: System compromised!
compromised.body: Your data is now encrypted and has been transferred to external servers. You fired all the innocent people and left the path clear for me. Thank you for your cooperation.
compromised.lesson: You failed. You focused too much on distractions (poorly stored passwords, public networks, using email for AI). Those are bad practices that require training, but you ignored the signs of an active attack: an unknown USB and hidden processes on Mía's monitor. You must restart the simulator and pay more attention to technical details.
